name: 38464 · Lawrenceburg, TN
findings: ZIP 38464 (Lawrenceburg) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38464 (Lawrenceburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 38464 (Lawrenceburg) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
